entities.summary: Andrew Jacob Gordon is a Canadian former professional ice hockey right winger who currently works for the Ottawa Senators as an amateur scout. He played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Washington Capitals, Anaheim Ducks and the Vancouver Canucks.
